name: Ultrasonic distance sensor (HC-SR04)
description: Measures distance with sound, like a bat. Send a HIGH pulse of at least 10 µs on TRIG; the sensor then sets ECHO HIGH for 58 µs per centimetre to the obstacle (pulseIn(echoPin, HIGH) / 58 = distance in cm). Range 2–400 cm; with nothing in range ECHO stays HIGH for 38 ms. Power it from 5 V. Drag the Distance slider in the inspector while the simulation runs to move the obstacle.
